status: Native Puppet Warp verified in bounded contexts; G02 and full parity remain open.
scope: Coverage mesh, editable pins/rotation/depth, ARAP/ASAP modes, density/expansion, native preview/local history and one document commit, retained Smart Filters and ordinary raster bake, native25 and matching Photato API.

primary_references.use: Pin, density, expansion, rotation and overlap-depth workflow reference; not numerical equivalence.

api.persistence: Editable programs require native25; older downloads reject. Ordinary baked pixels use their existing minimum version.
api.adobe: No dedicated Puppet operation in the pinned Firefly contract; unverified actionJSON and editable PSD descriptors reject explicitly. No invented route.

menus.shortcuts: No invented factory shortcut; existing Enter/Escape and local Undo/Redo.
menus.rust_alias: Rust Layer > Smart Objects > Puppet Warp is accessed through the captured Photoshop Edit command, not an extra factory Layer entry.

tests.live: No new live UI inspection; last desktop evidence locked. Offscreen layout is separate evidence.
tests.qualification: Original Rust/analytical, native/history/offscreen and actual HTTP checks. No new live/physical-platform evidence; exact Adobe output unqualified.

limits: Unlocked RGB raster or Smart Object targets without selection/vector masks. Other types can first be converted to Smart Objects. Alpha/Quick Mask filtering explicitly rejects at the shared API/core boundary.
64 pins,8192 vertices,40 solver iterations;8,388,608 source/output pixels, bounded coverage/factorization/raster work. API retains its4MP/64-layer/128MiB limits.
Mesh/solver translated from original Rust; exact Photoshop mesh, solver and pixels remain unqualified.
Editable PSD/PSB Puppet descriptor transport is unsupported; explicit rasterization or native25 is required.
Filter masks remain in document space and layer masks outside the Smart Filter pipeline. Nonlinear mask/feather fidelity remains open.

Single-pin selection, separate native sheet and numeric rotation/depth controls provide the major workflow. Exact inline Photoshop layout, multi-pin manipulation, temporary hide shortcuts, accessibility and live/platform qualification remain open.
General nonuniform-affine fixed-pin rotation semantics remain unqualified. Perspective Warp and other G02 contexts remain outstanding.
next: Perspective Warp: linked layout quads, homography warp/straightening, native preview/history, source-preserving Smart Filters and shared API.
